mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, side, buy_at, buy_price, quantity, stop_pct, memo, broker, created_at FROM holding ORDER BY buy_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding (symbol, side, buy_at, buy_price, quantity, stop_pct, memo, broker) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{side}, #{buyAt}, #{buyPrice}, #{quantity}, #{stopPct}, #{memo}, #{broker})
mapper.update: UPDATE holding SET stop_pct = #{stopPct} WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
UPDATE holding SET broker = #{broker} WHERE id = #{id}
